description:
List fulfillment issues. With order_uuid: that order's issues plus its report-window eligibility. Without: the workspace-wide issues inbox, filterable by status ('open_any' = open + filed upstream) and store, with limit/offset paging. Read-only.

[#533758]

order_uuid.description: Scope to one order (the inbox filters below apply only without it).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: list_fulfillment_issues
